event_note: June 2022 monsoon flood; exact breach date not verified
aoi_reason: Kurua village (OSM node, 26.2376N 91.8206E, Sipajhar, Darrang) on the Brahmaputra north bank, where the Rangamati-Kuruwa bund breach was reported; flooded floodplain north of it visible in Sentinel-1 30 Jun 2022. Breach point itself is not mapped in OSM (approximate).
